title: ever OPAL|Satin Drop Shoulder Sleeve Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
Why you'll love it

  • Draped one-shoulder neckline frames the collarbone and looks polished in photos from every angle.
  • Drop shoulder sleeve detail adds a touch of coverage and makes the silhouette feel more ¡°even¡± and balanced.
  • Stretch satin comfort gives you that glossy, elevated look without feeling stiff¡ªeasier to sit, walk, and dance.
  • Clean, flattering lines with soft ruching through the waist/hip area help smooth and streamline.

Best for
Bridesmaids, formal wedding guests, black-tie optional events, evening galas, prom, award-night dinners.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Side right zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises satin.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
